name: driftless
description: Hands off before context rot: a goal that never drifts, a living design doc, a self-compressing logbook, and an automatic handoff that resumes in a fresh session.

token_cap.title: Context cap (tokens)
token_cap.description: Optional: 260000, 340000 or 400000 (the most). Leave empty and Driftless hands off when a fresh start costs less than carrying on, by 260000 at the latest. A project's own cap (cap 260k|340k|400k) wins; with a percentage too, the lower wins.

cap_percent.title: Context cap (% of the window)
cap_percent.description: Optional. Hand off at this percentage of the context window instead (e.g. 34), never past 400000 tokens. The window is inferred from the model; set context_window in .driftless/config.json to force it.

carry_bypass.title: Fresh session keeps bypass
carry_bypass.description: Off by default. When a session that runs with permissions bypassed hands off, the fresh session edits without asking and asks before anything else. Turn this on to let it bypass permissions too: it starts with nobody watching it.

projects_root.title: Projects folder
projects_root.description: Where new Driftless projects are created.
